title: Console: a lookup to a record whose object the reader may not read shows a linked raw id, not the restricted-record placeholder
body:
domain:ui#3 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jV4dWohojjbTJTQq5m

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a (a measured display defect), from #29462 (PR #29639; os-dev report 6591156319, `/mnt/project-files/issue-29462/os-dev-report.md`). Filed by `domain:ui#3`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** objectui#13335 gave a lookup to a record the reader may not open a "restricted record" placeholder, so the reader sees that the record exists but is not theirs to open. When the refusal comes from the target object's read gate (no read permission on the whole object), the lookup cell instead draws the raw id with a question mark, inside a link to a record page that will refuse them. That looks like broken data, and the link leads to an error page.

**Observed** by the #29462 os-dev, live on `pnpm dev:crm`. A member whose object gate refuses `rnv_payroll` opens an `rnv_expense` record whose lookup `Payroll` points at it. The lookup has no `referenceNameVisible`. The cell draws the unresolved face (id + "?", linked) instead of the placeholder. Screenshot: `/mnt/project-files/issue-29462/shots/desktop-record.png`, field "Payroll (no key)".

Cause, read from source at #29462 head `7fb3a29d`, `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`:
- `useLookupName` (~L265) reports `state: 'absent'` only for a not-found answer.
- `LookupCellRenderer` (~L2733) gives the restricted face only to an `absent` id (`restrictedId`).
- An object-gate refusal answers the record read with 403. That is a failure, not `absent`, so the id falls through to `unresolved: true`.

**Wanted.** A 403 or permission-refused answer on the lookup's record read is drawn like a not-found: the restricted placeholder, with no link. A transient failure (network, 5xx) keeps today's unresolved face. Check whether the record read's error carries a status or code the cell can read (the data adapter's typed error). If not, say what it would need.

**Tests.**
- A recording adapter answers the lookup's read with 403: the cell shows the placeholder with no anchor.
- A 404 CONTROL is unchanged.
- A 5xx CONTROL keeps the unresolved face.
- The ablation goes red.
- `lookupCell.restrictedRecord-13335.test.tsx` stays green.

**Landing site:** `ui/packages/fields` (`useLookupName` / `LookupCellRenderer`). Serialize after PR #29639 (#29462), which edits the same renderer.

Dedupe: `is:issue restricted record placeholder 403`, `is:issue useLookupName 403`, `is:issue lookup unresolved object gate` (only #29462 and QA runs).

Links back: #29462, PR #29639, objectui#13335.
